census_command: $items = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '(?i)godot' } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,ExecutablePath,CommandLine); [pscustomobject]@{ GodotProcessCount = $items.Count; Processes = $items } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4
authorized_scope: One v2 candidate full run; no live edits; subsequent independent artifact/image review
